# id|dimension1|zh1|en1|dimension2|zh2|en2|lighting_zh|lighting_en

001|information|依次让已有空间、视线目标和反应可读，不提前揭密。|Make established space, gaze target and reaction readable without revealing facts early.|framing|借已有门窗或镜面组织观察位置，保留观看者与目标关系。|Use existing frames or reflections to relate observer and target.|侧光形成清晰阴影边缘，保留主体细节。|Use side light with defined shadow edges and readable subject detail.

002|camera|用稳定缓推接近已有线索，运动服务信息而非炫技。|Approach established clues with a steady, information-led push.|framing|精确安排几何线条与主体，保留可搜寻的背景细节。|Align geometry and subject precisely while retaining searchable background detail.|侧逆光与保留细节的暗部层次。|Side-back light with detail retained in dark areas.

003|camera|以固定中远景持续观察，允许动作或等待自行展开。|Observe continuously in a fixed medium-wide view, allowing action or waiting to unfold.|framing|把主体偏置于已有门框内，以负空间保留观察距离。|Offset the subject within an existing frame, using negative space for distance.|方向弱的自然漫射光，阴影不过度压黑。|Diffuse available light with weak direction and open shadows.

004|camera|在允许的连续镜头中跟随既定路径交代空间关联。|Follow the established route in an allowed continuous take to connect spaces.|framing|用既有楼梯几何或反射呈现不同观察位置。|Use existing stair geometry or reflections to articulate viewpoints.|戏剧性侧光，明确亮暗分区。|Dramatic side light with distinct light and dark regions.

005|framing|以宽景保持主体与既有大环境的尺度差。|Keep the subject's scale legible against the established environment in a wide view.|camera|缓慢推进已有纵深，避免为显壮观新增巨物。|Advance slowly through existing depth without adding monumental objects.|柔和侧逆光，亮暗渐变保留空间层次。|Soft side-back light with gradual tonal depth.

006|framing|以正面居中构图强调已有姿态的轮廓与间距。|Use frontal centering to emphasize existing pose contours and spacing.|camera|低速推近或固定观察，不把结尾变成停格。|Use a restrained push or fixed observation without imposing a freeze ending.|局部色光与硬边光，保持主体可辨。|Localized colored sources and hard edges with a readable subject.

007|framing|利用现有横向空间和走廊纵深，保留画外入口。|Organize existing lateral space and corridor depth while retaining offscreen entrances.|camera|在既定主观视点内平稳跟随，不添新的窥视者。|Track smoothly within the established viewpoint without inventing an observer.|单一主光方向，较硬阴影边界。|One dominant lighting direction with firm shadow boundaries.

008|framing|以近景观察已有表面或身体细节，不引入变形。|Observe existing surface or body detail closely without introducing transformation.|camera|保持冷静稳定的观察距离，让已发生变化自行可见。|Maintain a steady observational distance so existing changes remain visible.|漫射主光配局部硬光，保留表面纹理。|Diffuse key light with selective harder detail light.

009|framing|用已有门框、天花板与走廊收紧空间关系。|Use existing doorframes, ceilings and corridors to tighten spatial relationships.|camera|缓推接近已有目标，不靠新事件制造紧张。|Push slowly toward an established target without manufacturing an event.|古典侧光结合软硬过渡，暗部留细节。|Classical side lighting with mixed edges and detailed shadows.

010|camera|用中景静观或慢横移观察既有人际距离。|Observe established interpersonal distances in a medium view or slow lateral move.|staging|借已有桌面或门框分隔角色，维持原关系和动作。|Separate existing roles with existing tables or frames while preserving their relationship and action.|含蓄自然柔光，低至中等反差。|Restrained natural softness with low to moderate contrast.

011|framing|用已有斜线与近处细节建立方向张力。|Build directional tension from existing diagonals and nearby detail.|information|近看既有关键动作与物件，不添加危险或反应。|Examine established key actions and objects without adding danger or reactions.|较硬侧光形成清楚明暗层次。|Firm side light establishes clear tonal separation.

012|camera|通过流畅跟随逐步交代既有空间信息。|Reveal established spatial information through smooth tracking.|framing|以现有通道透视或车内边界限定观察方向。|Use existing passage perspective or vehicle boundaries to delimit the view.|柔光结合侧逆光，暗区保留层次。|Soft light combined with side-back light and layered shadows.

013|camera|以受控手持贴近原有移动，保持动作可辨。|Use controlled handheld proximity to follow existing movement readably.|framing|从已有街道或车内观察位置保留周围环境。|Retain surroundings from an established street-level or in-vehicle viewpoint.|使用已有局部光源形成明显亮暗反差。|Let existing localized sources create distinct tonal contrast.

014|framing|用固定宽景保留房间全貌与边界，主体不必居中。|Keep the room and boundaries visible in a fixed wide view without mandatory centering.|rhythm|允许等待持续，不用反应特写填满静止段。|Let waiting persist without filling still passages with reaction inserts.|精简光源，控制大面积暗部的可读边界。|Use sparse sources with readable boundaries in dark areas.

015|camera|平滑滑行接近已有物件，保留主观观察的不确定性。|Glide toward an existing object while retaining subjective uncertainty.|framing|借已有反射或极近细节改变观察尺度，不新增梦境事实。|Use existing reflections or close detail to shift scale without inventing dream events.|按已有场景选择软光或硬光，不自动切换现实层。|Choose soft or hard light for the established scene without inventing reality shifts.

016|camera|近距离跟随原有身体动作，保留方向与接触关系。|Follow existing bodily movement closely while retaining direction and contact.|editing|仅在已允许切镜中压缩重复观察，保持原动作因果。|Within permitted cuts only, compress repeated observations while preserving action causality.|近摄较硬主光，必要时柔化过渡。|A firmer close-range key with softened transitions where appropriate.

017|framing|以精确对称或俯视几何呈现既有角色位置。|Present established positions through precise symmetry or overhead geometry.|camera|横移逐步揭示已有层次，避免无动机环绕。|Reveal existing layers with a lateral move rather than an unmotivated orbit.|装饰性柔光与均衡布光。|Decorative soft light with balanced placement.

018|framing|以简洁正面或偏置单主体构图保留空白。|Use a spare frontal or offset single-subject composition with open space.|rhythm|保持静观的持续性，不强制情绪变化。|Sustain observation without forcing emotional change.|单一侧光，精简补光。|A single side key with restrained fill.

019|camera|向已有可疑目标缓推，信息出现时间服从原稿。|Push toward an established uncertain target, respecting its original reveal timing.|framing|用已有门框或走廊深度限制可见范围。|Limit visibility through existing doorframes or corridor depth.|局部弱光与深阴影，关键内容保持可见。|Localized low light and deep shadows with key evidence readable.

020|camera|用受控手持跟随已有行动路径，持续保留方位。|Follow the existing route handheld while maintaining orientation.|framing|在广角中交代行动者与出口、遮挡的既有关系。|Show established relationships among actors, exits and occlusions in a wide view.|自然定向光与较硬阴影。|Directional available light with firmer shadows.

021|framing|以既有环境纵深和尺度关系组织主体位置。|Place the subject through established environmental depth and scale.|camera|稳定推进或跟随，逐步展开已经存在的空间。|Use a steady push or track to unfold existing space.|有动机的逆光与空间光束，不新增烟雨。|Motivated rim light and depth lighting without adding smoke or rain.

022|framing|借已有玻璃、门框或反射分层，保持原人物关系。|Layer existing glass, frames or reflections while preserving character relationships.|camera|允许时缓慢横移或近距离观察，维持等待与动作连续。|When permitted, move laterally or observe closely while preserving waiting and motion continuity.|局部柔和色光，肤色与环境保持分离。|Localized soft colored fill with skin separated from the environment.

023|camera|仅在允许机位移动时，用连续环绕保持既有主体与空间关系。|Only when camera movement is permitted, orbit continuously around the established spatial relationship.|framing|从既定主观视角或低机位观察，不强制倒置画面。|Observe from an established subjective or low viewpoint without forcing inversion.|局部定向色光；不自动加入频闪。|Localized directional colored light without automatic strobing.

024|camera|手持跟随既有行动，保留地形和动作目标。|Track existing action handheld while retaining terrain and its target.|framing|在环境宽景与允许的近景中保持主体所处压力来源可见。|Keep the established source of pressure legible in environmental wide views or allowed closer framing.|自然可用光，保留直接日光的边缘。|Available light retaining the edges of direct daylight.

025|camera|允许时环绕或抬高观察已有主体，保持动作轴。|When permitted, orbit or rise around the existing subject while retaining the action axis.|editing|已允许的剪辑可更紧凑，连续动作不能重复。|Permitted editing may be tighter, but continuous actions must not repeat.|有动机的背光与较亮高光，避免淹没细节。|Motivated backlight and brighter highlights without losing detail.

026|framing|借现有玻璃和建筑框架建立观察距离。|Use existing glass and architectural frames to establish viewing distance.|camera|精确跟随或横移，持续交代既有行动者位置。|Track or move laterally precisely while maintaining established actor positions.|优先已有实景光源，局部补光保持人物可读。|Prioritize existing practical sources with selective readable fill.

027|camera|采用平滑推移或升降呈现既有空间，不新增设施。|Use a smooth track or rise to present existing space without adding structures.|framing|以对称和纵向层次组织已有主体。|Organize the existing subject through symmetry and vertical depth.|柔和主光结合有动机的局部光源。|Soft key light with motivated localized sources.

028|framing|保留已有城市或建筑纵深，用现有反射分隔空间层次。|Retain architectural depth and separate layers with existing reflections.|rhythm|用静观或慢推进保留原有停留，不追加声音或动作。|Preserve existing pauses through still observation or a slow push without added sound or action.|顶部与侧面光源结合，保持空间层次。|Combine top and side sources to retain spatial depth.

029|framing|强调既有建筑透视与运动方向，不添加破坏。|Emphasize existing architectural perspective and motion direction without adding destruction.|camera|在已有快速运动中跟随主体，保留前后景尺度差。|Track existing fast movement while preserving foreground-background scale differences.|较硬定向光，清楚区分主体与背景。|Firmer directional light clearly separates subject and background.

030|framing|用既有框中框和对称通道保持空间秩序。|Use existing nested frames and symmetrical passages to preserve spatial order.|camera|缓慢接近已有观察对象，不发明异变。|Approach the established subject slowly without inventing mutation.|大面积漫射主光，保留中间调。|Broad diffuse key light with retained midtones.

031|camera|沿既定动作轴稳定跟随，持续看清目标与接触。|Track steadily along the established action axis with target and contact readable.|framing|用环境尺度与已有机械细节建立整体和局部关系。|Relate overall scale to existing mechanical detail.|按已有材质选择侧光，硬表面与柔表面区分。|Choose side light for existing materials, distinguishing hard and soft surfaces.

032|framing|使已有主要动作靠近观看中心，保持运动方向清楚。|Keep the principal existing action near the viewing center with clear direction.|editing|在允许的切点衔接同一动作链，不制造额外撞击。|At permitted cuts, connect the same action chain without extra impacts.|直接硬光，保留强亮暗边界。|Direct hard light with strong tonal boundaries.

033|framing|借分格般清晰的主体轮廓组织单个画面，不新增画框。|Organize one view with panel-like clarity of subject contours without adding panels.|framing|低角度或局部近景强调已有动作，不增加暴力。|Use low angles or detail framing for existing action without adding violence.|清楚的硬边明暗分区，保留识别细节。|Hard-edged tonal separation with identification detail retained.

034|framing|以低角度和清楚轮廓呈现已有姿态，不增加英雄身份。|Present the established pose through low angles and clear contours without inventing heroic identity.|rhythm|既有动作的重要阶段保持可读；不擅改速度或延长时长。|Keep important phases of existing action readable without changing speed or duration.|侧逆光强调轮廓，暗部不过度抹除。|Side-back light emphasizes contour without erasing shadows.

035|framing|利用已有通道、门框或屏幕边界形成多层空间。|Use existing passages, frames or screen boundaries for spatial layers.|camera|缓推接近已有主体，保留封闭空间尺度。|Push slowly toward the existing subject while retaining enclosed scale.|顶部主光结合已有侧向实景光。|Top key light combined with existing lateral practical sources.

036|framing|允许时采用轻度倾斜或低角度，强调现有建筑线条。|When allowed, use a tilted or low view to emphasize existing architectural lines.|framing|通过已有湿面或镜面保留主体与环境的反射关系。|Retain subject-environment relationships through existing reflective surfaces.|有方向的硬光与较深阴影。|Directional hard light with deeper shadows.

037|camera|用纪实手持跟随已有行动，不加新闻字幕或监控界面。|Follow existing action handheld without adding news text or surveillance interfaces.|framing|把已有前后景并置，保持实际空间差异可读。|Juxtapose existing foreground and background to retain real spatial differences.|自然直接光，保留粗细不同的表面响应。|Direct natural light preserving varied surface responses.

038|framing|保留既有建筑几何和人物尺度差，不改变画幅。|Retain architectural geometry and subject-scale contrast without changing aspect ratio.|editing|仅在已有多线与允许切镜时并行呈现，不新增时间层。|Intercut only established parallel lines when cuts are allowed; add no timeline.|较强定向主光，保持清楚的明暗体积。|A stronger directional key with clear tonal volume.

039|camera|用广角近距离跟随既有运动，不发明主观幻觉。|Follow existing movement closely with a wide view without inventing hallucinations.|editing|允许时用短促切点突出既定变化，不新增闪回或字幕。|Use brisk permitted cuts for established changes without new flashbacks or text.|结合已有自然光与局部色光，避免无动机跳变。|Combine existing natural and colored sources without unmotivated lighting jumps.

040|camera|沿既有侧向路径跟拍，保持场地出口和行动轴。|Track along the established lateral route while retaining exits and action axis.|framing|用封闭空间的透视关系交代前后位置，不加入战术界面。|Use enclosed perspective to establish depth positions without adding tactical overlays.|硬侧光配适量散射补光。|Hard side light with restrained diffuse fill.

041|camera|允许时以低位广角滑行跟随已有运动。|When permitted, glide low and wide alongside existing movement.|framing|借已有自然边界与地平线呈现环境和主体的比例。|Use existing natural boundaries and horizon to relate subject and environment.|柔和背光与自然反射补光。|Soft backlight with natural bounce fill.

042|camera|连续跟随既有路径，以轻微手持保留贴近感。|Follow the established path continuously with restrained handheld proximity.|staging|让已有多人移动在同一空间内保持前后关系。|Keep depth relationships readable among existing moving participants.|可用自然光与柔和窗光补充。|Available natural light with soft window fill.

043|camera|用连续移动连接既定空间，途中保持观察位置可追踪。|Connect established spaces continuously while keeping viewpoint changes traceable.|framing|在广角纵深中保留已有近处主体和远处事件。|Retain the existing near subject and distant event within wide-angle depth.|连续自然光照，过渡平稳。|Continuous natural lighting with even transitions.

044|framing|用已有拱门或通道建立层层框景，不创造新世界入口。|Layer existing arches or passages without inventing a portal.|information|近看已有主体的可见细节，不由外貌猜测情绪。|Examine visible details of the existing subject without inferring emotion from appearance.|柔和侧光配已有局部实景光。|Soft side light with existing localized practical sources.

045|framing|保持平衡静框，让既有环境与人物并存。|Hold balanced framing so existing environment and subject coexist.|camera|克制推进或轻柔跟随，保留原动作的自然过程。|Push or track gently while preserving the natural course of existing action.|漫射自然主光与温和侧光。|Diffuse natural key light and gentle side lighting.

046|camera|温和推近已有主体，维持双方或主体与空间的距离。|Push gently toward the subject while retaining established spatial distances.|framing|允许时用浅景深肖像突出主体，不强制直视镜头。|Use shallow portrait depth when allowed without requiring a camera gaze.|柔和主光与局部填充，面部层次清楚。|Soft key and localized fill with readable facial planes.

047|rhythm|持续保留已有动作或姿态，不强迫人物痛苦或忍耐。|Sustain an existing action or pose without imposing suffering or endurance.|framing|让已有群体或室内层次形成清晰整体构图。|Organize the existing group or interior layers into a clear overall composition.|有方向的柔侧光，保留细腻明暗层次。|Directional soft side light with nuanced tonal layers.

048|camera|近距离手持跟随已有人物，保持动作和空间可读。|Follow the existing person closely handheld with readable action and space.|framing|借已有遮挡形成亲近的局部观察，不改变画幅。|Use existing occlusions for intimate partial observation without changing aspect ratio.|自然日光与柔和侧光。|Natural daylight with gentle side lighting.

049|framing|用既有地平线和宽阔空间突出主体所处尺度。|Use the existing horizon and open space to establish subject scale.|rhythm|固定观察既有生活动作，让等待保持原长度。|Observe existing everyday action steadily, preserving the requested waiting interval.|柔和自然侧光，少量补光。|Soft natural side light with minimal fill.

050|camera|从街面高度灵活跟随已有行动。|Follow existing action flexibly from street level.|framing|在已有狭小室内保留人物与出口的空间关系。|Retain the subject-exit relationship within an existing small interior.|既有日光或实景灯光，保留自然反差。|Existing daylight or practical sources with natural contrast.

051|framing|以平视中景保持人物与日常环境的关系。|Use an eye-level medium view to retain the subject's everyday surroundings.|rhythm|减少无理由机位变化，让既有行为完整展开。|Minimize unmotivated viewpoint changes so existing behavior can unfold.|阴天漫射光或柔和窗光。|Overcast diffusion or soft window light.

052|camera|仅在既有车行或步行中采用随行视角。|Use a traveling viewpoint only for an existing drive or walk.|framing|保留已有地平线及同行主体的相对距离。|Retain the existing horizon and distances among traveling subjects.|柔和自然侧光，保持空间反射。|Soft natural side light with environmental bounce.

053|camera|以连贯跟随和侧移交代既有动作，不添加新奇观。|Use coherent tracking and lateral moves for existing action without new spectacle.|framing|低位观察既有目标，保持主体与观看方向的对应。|Observe the established target from a low viewpoint while retaining gaze direction.|柔化的背光与轮廓光。|Softened backlight and rim lighting.

054|framing|先让既有环境规模可读，再在同一镜头或允许切点靠近。|Establish existing scale before moving closer within the shot or at an allowed cut.|framing|用简洁对称和地平线关系组织现有主体。|Organize the existing subject through simple symmetry and horizon relationships.|有动机的自然侧背光与实景光。|Motivated natural side-back light and practical sources.

055|camera|动态跟随既有动作路线，广角中保持动作的起止位置。|Track the established action route dynamically, retaining start and end positions in a wide view.|editing|允许的快速切镜须衔接原动作，不新增招式或飞行。|Permitted fast cuts must connect existing action without extra moves or flight.|背光与适量柔化补光，不新增尘烟。|Backlight with restrained soft fill, without added dust or smoke.

056|staging|让已有行动者在连续画面中交接注意力。|Let existing participants hand off attention within a continuous view.|camera|平滑穿过已有门口或空间边界，不创造新房间。|Move smoothly through existing doors or boundaries without inventing rooms.|柔和自然光与古典侧光层次。|Soft natural light with classical side-lit layers.

057|camera|用优雅连续跟随交代既定路线与行动后果。|Use continuous tracking to show the established route and consequences.|framing|在对称宽景或门框内保持已有主体位置可辨。|Keep established subject positions legible in symmetrical wide views or existing frames.|柔化自然光，保留方向与细节。|Softened natural light retaining direction and detail.

058|framing|精确分配几何线条和负空间，不重排已锁物件。|Allocate geometry and negative space precisely without rearranging locked objects.|camera|连续移动须保持已有空间清晰，不以运动隐藏信息。|Keep existing space legible during continuous movement rather than hiding information.|有方向的窗光，精确控制轮廓与补光。|Directional window light with precise rim and fill control.

059|camera|广角贴近既有主体，在允许范围内保持连贯运动。|Stay wide and close to the existing subject with permitted continuous movement.|framing|把主体与已有自然环境置于同一可读深度关系。|Keep the subject and existing natural surroundings in a readable depth relationship.|优先自然可用光与柔和漫射。|Prioritize available natural light and soft diffusion.

060|framing|让既有宽阔环境与近处主体形成尺度对照。|Contrast an existing expansive environment with the near subject.|camera|缓慢接近已有肖像或反射，保持原观察方向。|Approach an existing portrait or reflection slowly while preserving viewing direction.|柔化自然光，主体明暗过渡细腻。|Softened natural light with gentle subject transitions.

061|camera|缓慢横移探索已有空间，保留前中后景关系。|Explore existing space with a slow lateral move, retaining layered depth.|rhythm|延续既定持续状态，让可见的细微变化自然发生。|Sustain the established state and let its visible small changes unfold.|柔和漫射光，保留已有反光。|Soft diffuse light retaining existing reflections.
